prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent upper-left outer-page ornament for a medieval illuminated manuscript journal.
Edit the reference corner ornament. Preserve its hand-painted antique gold leaf, oak leaves, acorns, dark ink outlines, fine top and left outer gold rules, leaf-shaped end finials, upper-left orientation, and overall 3:4 proportions. Redesign the INNER boundary as free curling filigree: graceful C-scrolls, S-curves, rounded leaf lobes, and a flowing scalloped silhouette opening toward the lower-right reading area. Let the gold stems and leaves form the structure themselves, with transparent spaces between them. Replace the broad triangular indigo infill with small curved indigo ribbons and recessed pockets nestled inside the gold scrolls. Remove the straight diagonal brace and the continuous triangular gold outline completely. The inside edge must flow through curves and leaf tips, with no triangular wedge, chamfer, stepped corner, zigzag, or polygonal plate. The outer top and left page rules may remain straight; the organic filigree should soften their junction. Keep enough weight and contrast for the ornament to read when 80 pixels wide. Keep most of the canvas, especially the lower-right area, genuinely transparent. Flat medieval manuscript illumination, subtle pigment and gold-leaf texture. No page background, text, numerals, letters, extra objects, bevel, shadow, or glow. Deliver one isolated ornament, using approximately the same occupied envelope and placement as the reference.
processing: Resize to 256 pixels wide with cwebp; encode at quality 90 and alpha quality 100. Preserve alpha. CSS mirrors and rotates the ornament for the four outer page corners.
